ruleDefinitions.name: Potentially Suspicious Child Processes Spawned by ConHost
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious child processes related to Windows Shell utilities spawned by `conhost.exe`, which could indicate malicious activity using trusted system components.

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\conhost\\\.exe$") AND ((process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\_ise\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "cmd\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "cscript\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "mshta\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "powershell\_ise\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "powershell\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "pwsh\.dll" OR process_original_file_name = "regsvr32\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "wscript\.exe")))
